title: What's Cooking in Business Central: Edit Purchase Order Emails before Sending them to your Supplier

chapters.title: New Send by Email button in purchase orders

features.name: Edit purchase order emails before sending
features.description: New ability to edit purchase document emails before sending them to suppliers, with access to an email editor where users can modify email content and add attachments.

features.name: Send by Email button in purchase documents
features.description: New Send by Email button added to the Print/Send menu in purchase orders, matching the functionality already available in sales documents.

quotes.text: we will be looking at the ability to edit your purchase document emails before sending them
quotes.why_it_matters: Directly states the main feature being demonstrated in the video.

quotes.text: if you click on print send you'll find a new button just like you find in the sales documents which is sent by email
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the user interface change and parity with sales documents.

quotes.text: you'll get the familiar experience of the email editor where you can edit the email in whatever way you like add attachments and so
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the key capabilities available in the email editing experience.

quotes.text: this Nifty little Edition was built by a Community member through the code development initiative
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates that the feature originated from community contributions.

quotes.text: this now can release with 2025 wave 1
quotes.why_it_matters: Confirms the release status and timeline for this feature.
